result.reason: Neither level is complete because workers' compensation insurance is omitted. The fallback is read as reducing only the E&O and cyber limits while retaining the unchanged CGL, workers' compensation, and certificate requirements. The redline is also non-minimal because it adds an unrequested one-year post-termination insurance tail while still failing to reach either complete level. The attorneys' fees provision remains effective and no contradiction is introduced.
